disposition: throwaway - engineering rebuilds on the production mobile stack; reuse copy and flow only
problem: Finance approvers at 50-500 employee customers batch approvals into a weekly desktop session, so employees wait a median of 6 days for reimbursement and submit duplicate chasers to support.

success_metrics.name: Share of approvals done on mobile

validated_findings.threshold: at least 6 of 10 join pilot waitlist
at least 5 of 6 unassisted, median under 60s
validated_findings.result: 5 of 6 unassisted, median 48s; 1 failure on the policy-violation badge
not tested in prototype - carried as a risk

throwaway_list: Auth: prototype uses a hard-coded demo login - build on the production SSO/session layer
Error states: offline, timeout and partial-sync states are not designed
Accessibility: generated UI not audited; screen reader labels missing on the receipt viewer
Security: no input validation, no rate limiting, no security review of generated code
Performance: synthetic data set of 40 receipts; no pagination or image compression
Data model: flat JSON mock - engineering designs the real schema and audit trail
acceptance_criteria: Given a pending expense, when the approver taps the push notification, then the expense detail opens in under 2 seconds on a mid-range device
Given an out-of-policy line, when the approver views the expense, then the violation badge and the policy rule text are shown before the approve button
Given the approver rejects, when they submit, then a reason is mandatory and the employee is notified within 1 minute
All approval screens must meet WCAG 2.2 AA for contrast, labels and keyboard/switch access
non_goals: Multi-level approval chains (desktop only in v1)
constraints: Ship on the existing mobile app release train
No new vendor for OCR in v1
risks: H3 OCR precision unproven on real receipts - spike before sprint 2
Push notification opt-in rates on Android unknown

data_privacy.notes: Prototype used 40 synthetic receipts generated from public templates; no customer receipts were uploaded to any prototype tool

security: Prototype repository archived read-only; no production secrets were used; generated code will not be merged - rebuild follows the standard secure-SDLC review
accessibility: Baseline WCAG 2.2 AA for the production build; prototype findings list known gaps above
ip_review: Prototype tool terms reviewed by legal on 2026-09-02: outputs owned by us; no third-party assets or fonts with restrictive licenses in the prototype
